contexts.text: Without conscience... the good flowing in from the Lord flows through, like water through a sieve. AC 5032:3. AC 5145:5. AC 6368:2.
The Divine transflux through the Celestial Heaven (then). AC 6720.
The Divine which flows through Heaven is good.
The Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord flows through Heaven...
By a transflux of innocence from the Lord.
That which was from them was as it were transfluent.
If this were not so, the inflowing love and wisdom would... flow through and not affect.
If they did not do this as from themselves, the Divine influx and operation would flow through...
